Owner QA

Club Tier Readiness — QA walks

Stage 6b — the club calendar (every program’s week in one read-only place, with its clashes marked and counted), the Venue library redesigned (who can change it, a venue that reads first, rename, Archive and Delete) and weeks grouped in the club’s time — is walked as nine short walks (ledger §288): walks 1 to 6 passed 2026-10-09. During walk 6 the owner ruled that Archive needs no pinned row of its own: Archive, Bring back and a payee’s Merge now end the window’s body beside Delete, so walk 7’s first, seventh and eighth steps and walk 8’s first step were reworded the same day. Walk 4 passed on the first layout; the owner then moved Export up into the Filter row on a phone, and then took List off the phone’s View drawer, so its steps 2, 3 and 6 were reworded the same day and are owed a re-check: on a phone, Filter and Export’s icon share the row under the title and the icon opens the menu, and the View drawer offers Week and Month. Walks 1 to 4 only read. Walks 5 to 9 write test data and each puts back what it changes, except that walk 8 deletes the venue walk 5 adds, so walk 5 goes first. The rest go in any order.

Stage 6a — the club’s venues, the one clash check and one Venue field on every form that asks where — is walked as eight short walks (ledger §284), all passed 2026-10-09. Walk 4 follows walk 3 (it edits the series walk 3 makes); walks 1, 3, 6 and 7 write test data, so each can be walked once; the rest go in any order.

Stage 3d — the last club money pages become windows: Payees over the Ledger (from Tools, and from inside an entry), one allocation window every door opens, an allocation’s name and note, a closed year’s allocation, the old addresses and a phone — is walked as eight short walks (ledger §285), all passed 2026-10-09. Each tests one job and is signed off on its own. Walks 3 and 5 write test data (a payee merge, an allocation’s new name and note), so each can be walked once; walk 5 goes after walk 4, whose steps name Diamond fees 2026 as it is now. The rest go in any order.

Stage 3c — the club’s fiscal year: setting it, every tab reading it by name, closing and reopening it, a closed year read in place, the year that opens, the year-end papers, New allocation from a line and from Allocations, a payee’s window and the coach’s earlier-season bill — is walked as eleven short walks (ledger §283), all owed. Each one tests one job, says what it’s for before you start, and is signed off on its own — a walk can pass while another is still open. Walks 4, 5, 6 and 7 go in that order: walk 4 reopens 2025–26 and backdates a missed cheque, walk 5 closes it again, and walks 6 and 7 read what that leaves. The rest go in any order. Walks 1, 4, 5, 8 and 9 write test data, and so does walk 6’s last step, so each can be walked once. After them, Stage 3b’s walk 13 (the coach’s Ledger gaining a Category filter, ledger §280) and walk 14 (Item following Category on both Ledgers, ledger §281) are still owed. Stage 3b’s other twelve walks, Stage 3a’s six, Stage 2’s ten and Stage 1’s eight all passed and are kept below.

The test club is ready — walk it as it is. It was rebuilt on 2026-10-07 for Stage 3c: UAT Rep Club runs a September-to-August fiscal year. 2025–26 is closed (by Avery Chen, through the real close) and still held open money at its close: 13U AAA’s and 14U AA’s second payments on Permit share 2025–26, 15U AAA’s request for a Provincials hotel deposit, two lines filed under no word, and an uncleared cheque (Fence repair — Lions Park). 2026–27 is open, with its plan; Diamond permits — city fields still has some left to allocate (walk 8 bills it). 14U AA’s 2026 Season is finished and its 2027 Season runs, so its unpaid 2025–26 bill sits on an earlier season (walk 11). A second club, UAT Calendar Club (uat-calendar-club), is still on January, with a plan for 2026 and 2027; walk 1 moves it to September. Stage 3b’s and 3a’s money is all still there, and a line they dated in late summer now sits in 2025–26. The dev server was restarted and the test sign-ins refreshed on 2026-10-07. To rebuild UAT Rep Club, ask the chat (node --env-file=.env.local scripts/seed-club-fixture.mjs --reset, then node --env-file=.env.local scripts/seed-uat-coach-fixture.mjs); to rebuild only the calendar club, node --env-file=.env.local scripts/seed-club-fixture.mjs --calendar-club. ⚠ A rebuild resets the test accounts’ passwords, which signs every open window out: sign in again after one. A rebuild closes 2025–26 again on the day it runs, so the closed line then shows that day. Stage 6a’s venues were added on 2026-10-08 without a rebuild (node --env-file=.env.local scripts/seed-club-fixture.mjs --club-venues, which replaces only its own rows): Lions Park (Diamonds 1–3), Kinsmen Park (Diamonds A and B) and Westfield School, and a week of bookings on them around Tuesday, Oct 20: 14U AA on Lions Park Diamond 2 at 5:30–7:30 p.m. both Tuesdays (Oct 20 and 27); 13U AAA on the same diamond at 6:00–8:00 p.m. the first Tuesday; 11U AA on Kinsmen Park Diamond B at 6:00–7:30 p.m. both Tuesdays, and at Lions Park with no diamond on Wednesday, Oct 21; and house league’s Reds vs Blues on Kinsmen Park Diamond B on Thursday, Oct 22, 6:00–7:30 p.m. 13U AAA also keeps its own places, Lions Park and Centennial Park. Stage 6b needs nothing new: its walks use 6a’s seeded week (Mon Oct 19 – Sun Oct 25) as it is; the calendar opens on today’s week, so step forward with the arrows. Stage 3d needs nothing new: its walks use the club as it is. The treasurer’s bell holds the notice “13U AAA says they sent $450.00” (Diamond fees 2026, 2 of 3), seeded again on 2026-10-08 so it opens the new window; walk 3’s merge can be walked once (a rebuild brings Mizuno Canada Ltd. back).
